> 第23章 苦修（第1页）
苦修（苦修（第22页）在萧炎身后，化为灵魂状态的药老，正盘坐在一块巨石之上，此时，他正满脸肃然地望着那咬牙坚持的萧炎，手掌轻轻一挥。随着药老手掌的挥动，空气略微波动，一道淡红色的斗气匹练猛地自药老掌中暴射而出，最后宛如鞭子一般，重重的砸在了萧炎肩膀之上，顿时留下一道长长的淤痕。牙关紧咬的萧炎，眼角都在因为疼痛而微微抽搐，他只觉得自己的肩膀似乎忽然间麻木了下来，一阵阵火辣辣的疼痛直钻入心。在剧烈的疼痛过后，体内便是有药力流淌，肩膀处的脉络与穴位上，一股温热之意蔓延开来，药力渗透进骨骼肌肉之中，强化、修复着他的身体。“再来！”待得肩膀上的疼痛逐渐褪去，萧炎那稚嫩的小脸上，却满是认真之色。这个时候不付出努力和汗水，日后就只能望着被抓走的父亲和老师，无能的流下泪水了！但眼泪是不能改变任何事情的！望着那韧性十足的萧炎，药老那干枯的老脸上，挤出了一抹欣慰的笑意，微微点头，手掌中，淡红斗气再次飙射而出。“砰，砰，砰…”后山的树林之中，一道道有些渗人的闷响以及低沉的闷哼声，接连不断的传了开来。药老的下手极有分寸，每次的攻击，刚好是达到萧炎现在身体所能够承受的临界点，那样，既不会让重伤萧炎，又能给他带来极为清晰的痛感。斗气击打在身体之上的那种钻心疼痛，几乎让萧炎无法管理自己的表情。随着药老手掌的挥动，萧炎身上的淤痕也是越来越多…“砰！”又是一道斗气匹练射出，那犹如木桩一般的萧炎，终于是到达了所能承受的极限，身形微微摇晃，旋即便是直接一屁股坐在了地上，从纳戒里取出了一个玉瓶，将其中的丹药取出一粒，塞入口中，闭目沉神，消化药力。强化身体的丹药有两种。一种是挨打之前吃的养体丹，能够修复服药后一段时间内遭受到的身体损伤。另一种则是挨打之后吃的健体丹，能够促进身体素质的强化，这样一来，强化身体用的，就不是萧炎身体中，原本用来长个子的能量，如此一来，这种极端的训练手段，对他身体的影响，也会被消弥掉。身上的痛苦还未完全消散，但是萧炎还是沉下心来，将药力全部炼化。片刻后，萧炎睁开双眼，一身淤痕，也在药力的帮助下，彻底消散。“感觉倒是还不错。”虽然挨了半天的打，但萧炎并没有什么心理阴影。能够变强，还怕什么挨打啊！“今天差不多就这样吧，我估摸最多一个月的时间，这法子对你来说就用处不大了，再想要强化身体素质，恐怕只能依靠丹药和天材地宝了。”药老抚着胡须，淡笑着说道。“嗯？有人来了？”但下一刻，药老便目光一扫树林深处，身形化作流光，钻入萧炎手指上的纳戒中。萧炎伸手一抓，发动吸掌，将挂在树枝上的衣服抓了过来，将其穿好，目光望向密林深处，只见一道熟悉的身影，正在飞奔而来。

> Chapter 23 Penance (Page 1)
Penance (Page 22) Behind Xiao Yan, Yao Lao, who had transformed into a soul state, was sitting cross-legged on a boulder. At this time, he was looking solemnly at Xiao Yan, who was gritting his teeth and insisting, and waved his palm gently. As Yao Lao waved his palm, the air fluctuated slightly, and a light red fighting spirit suddenly shot out from Yao Lao's palm. Finally, like a whip, it hit Xiao Yan's shoulder heavily, leaving a long line. There were bruises. Xiao Yan clenched his teeth, and the corners of his eyes twitched slightly because of the pain. He felt that his shoulder suddenly became numb, and waves of burning pain penetrated his heart. After the severe pain, there was medicine flowing in his body, and a warmth spread in the veins and acupuncture points of his shoulders. The medicine penetrated into the bones and muscles, strengthening and repairing his body. "Come again!" The pain gradually subsided, but Xiao Yan's young face was full of seriousness. If he didn't put in effort and sweat at this time, he would just look at his father and teacher being taken away and cry helplessly! But tears can't change anything! Looking at the resilient Xiao Yan, a smile of relief appeared on Yao Lao's old face, and he nodded slightly, and the red fighting spirit burst out from his palms again. Bang..." In the woods at the back of the mountain, a series of permeating muffled sounds and low humming sounds were heard one after another. Yao Lao's attacks were very measured, and each attack happened to reach the critical point that Xiao Yan's body could bear. In this way, it would not seriously injure Xiao Yan, but also bring him a very clear sense of pain. The heartbreaking pain when the fighting spirit hit his body almost made Xiao Yan unable to control his expression. Then The bruises on Xiao Yan's body were getting more and more with the wave of the medicine-laden hand... "Bang!" Another shot of Dou Qi was shot out. Xiao Yan, who was like a wooden stake, finally reached the limit of what he could bear. He swayed slightly and sat down on the ground. He took out a jade bottle from the ring, took out one of the pills, stuffed it into his mouth, closed his eyes and concentrated, digesting the power of the pills. There are two types of pills. One is the body-building pill taken before being beaten, which can repair the physical damage suffered within a period of time after taking the medicine. The other is the body-building pill taken after being beaten, which can promote the strengthening of physical fitness. In this way, the energy used to strengthen Xiao Yan's body is not used to grow taller. In this way, the impact of this extreme training method on his body will be eliminated. The pain on his body has not completely dissipated, but Xiao Yan calmed down and refined all the power of the medicine. After a while, Xiao Yan opened his eyes, and the bruises on his body were completely dissipated with the help of the medicine. "It feels pretty good." Although he had been beaten for a long time, there was no psychological shadow. If you can become stronger, why should you be afraid of being beaten? "That's about it for today. I guess this method will not be of much use to you in a month at most. If you want to strengthen it, I'm afraid I can only rely on elixirs and treasures from heaven and earth." Yao Lao stroked his beard and said with a smile. "Huh? Is someone here?" But the next moment, Yao Lao glanced at the depths of the forest, and his figure turned into a stream of light, and got into the ring on Xiao Yan's finger. Xiao Yan reached out and grabbed the clothes hanging on the branches, put them on, and looked into the depths of the dense forest, only to see a familiar figure running towards him.
